query: Draw the flow of a voice turn: capture, transcribe, reason, speak.
inputs: capture audio -> transcribe -> reason with the model -> stream speech back
expected_behavior: emits a single well-formed svg in the svg-node/nodetext/flowlbl vocabulary
shows the four steps left to right with labelled directional edges
does not emit Mermaid or a code fence, just the svg

query: Draw a decision flow with a happy path and an error branch.
inputs: submit -> valid? yes: save; no: show error
expected_behavior: uses an accent to distinguish the error branch (coral) from the happy path
labels the branch edges with the condition

query: The idea has a dozen micro-steps; draw the flow.
expected_behavior: collapses to the few steps that carry the argument rather than drawing all twelve
